sections.name: Toyota Fortuner
lines: The Toyota Fortuner is built the old school way. A ladder frame chassis, shared with the Hilux pickup truck.
Its two point eight diesel makes two hundred and four P S, and up to five hundred newton metres with the automatic.
There is also a two point seven petrol, with a hundred and sixty six P S.
Four wheel drive versions get a low range gearbox and a locking rear differential, for serious off roading.
The ladder frame makes it tough on bad roads, but heavier, with more body roll than a monocoque SUV.

lines.label: seats
spec: third row folds to the sides

lines: Seven seats, with a third row that folds up against the sides.
The Legender and G R Sport versions add sharper styling and extra features.
Known for toughness and strong resale value, it is the go anywhere status symbol.
